slides.title: Where we were: learned selective recursion, and routing collapse.
slides.notes: Recap in one minute. RL from a taught warm start works on OOLONG. The route choice is the part RL cannot hold: every remedy we tried, and the literature's, collapses. The pair to stress: SFT can learn the rule; RL from the correct router loses it in two updates.

slides.title: Put the routine in a library: the untrained controller matches the trained ones.
slides.notes: The prelude is new kernel machinery: code bound before the first cell, listed by contract. The untrained 4B calls it correctly on both families. On the 293-row held-out OOLONG set it equals the scripted expert and beats the best RL controller with zero errors and fewer tokens. Teaching the call pattern buys only the cheap lookup route and costs four times the tokens on short tasks.

slides.title: Put the route choice in a table: no training, best accuracy, lowest cost.
slides.notes: Signature from the input text only. Table from teaching and train splits only. The note is a few lines of verified history with one recommendation. 120 of 120 follow it. Best accuracy and lowest tokens of any controller. Cannot collapse because nothing is trained.

slides.title: A library must not overclaim: what happens off its coverage.
slides.notes: Caution slide. The shipped docstring claimed every form; the controller submitted unknown 72 times. Honest contract: look at the question first, then aggregate. Top-buyer losses are format only. This motivates growth: a verified routine fixes format and budget.

slides.title: Grow the library by verification: the librarian loop.
slides.notes: Propose, verify on the model's own extractions, register with its record. Two forms recovered from zero to perfect with no training. Third form: all 24 of the 4B's candidates had the same sort-direction bug; verification kept them out; showing it the failures did not help. The 8B proposer, reasoning for about 5k tokens first, got it right on all eight candidates, and the 4B caller is then perfect on dev. Ceiling is the proposer, not the loop.

slides.title: What this changes, and what to test next.
slides.notes: Sharpened claim: capability in the library, selection in statistics, weights call and compose. Limits are real: synthetic, one seed, greedy table. Next tests are small and ready; the harder form and the 8B proposer come first.
